lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਕੀ ਤਿਉ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਿਵਾਸ ॥੧੪੧॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jiu bhagat kabeer kee tiu tiu raam nivaas ||141||
lines.translation: The more Kabeer worships Him, the more the Lord abides within his mind. ||141||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਗਹਗਚਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਕੈ ਕਾਂਠੈ ਰਹਿ ਗਇਓ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer gahagach pario kuta(n)b kai kaa(n)thai rahi gaio raam ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the mortal has fallen into the grip of family life, and the Lord has been set aside.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਪਰੇ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੇ ਬੀਚਹਿ ਧੂਮਾ ਧਾਮ ॥੧੪੨॥
lines.transliteration: aai pare dharam raai ke beechahi dhoomaa dhaam ||142||
lines.translation: The messengers of the Righteous Judge of Dharma descend upon the mortal, in the midst of all his pomp and ceremony. ||142||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਾਕਤ ਤੇ ਸੂਕਰ ਭਲਾ ਰਾਖੈ ਆਛਾ ਗਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer saakat te sookar bhalaa raakhai aachhaa gaau ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, even a pig is better than the faithless cynic; at least the pig keeps the village clean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਹੁ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਬਪੁਰਾ ਮਰਿ ਗਇਆ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਲੈਹੈ ਨਾਉ ॥੧੪੩॥
lines.transliteration: uhu saakat bapuraa mar gaiaa koi na laihai naau ||143||
lines.translation: When the wretched, faithless cynic dies, no one even mentions his name. ||143||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਕਉਡੀ ਕਉਡੀ ਜੋਰਿ ਕੈ ਜੋਰੇ ਲਾਖ ਕਰੋਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer kaudee kaudee jor kai jore laakh karor ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the mortal gathers wealth, shell by shell, accumulating thousands and millions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਲਤੀ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਕਛੁ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਲਈ ਲੰਗੋਟੀ ਤੋਰਿ ॥੧੪੪॥
lines.transliteration: chalatee baar na kachh milio laee la(n)gotee tor ||144||
lines.translation: But when the time of his departure comes, he takes nothing at all with him. He is even stripped of his loin-cloth. ||144||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਬੈਸਨੋ ਹੂਆ ਤ ਕਿਆ ਭਇਆ ਮਾਲਾ ਮੇਲੀਂ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer baisano hooaa ta kiaa bhaiaa maalaa melee(n) chaar ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, what good is it to become a devotee of Vishnu, and wear four malas?

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਬਾਰਹਾ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਭਰੀ ਭੰਗਾਰ ॥੧੪੫॥
lines.transliteration: baahar ka(n)chan baarahaa bheetar bharee bha(n)gaar ||145||
lines.translation: On the outside, he may look like pure gold, but on the inside, he is stuffed with dust. ||145||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਰੋੜਾ ਹੋਇ ਰਹੁ ਬਾਟ ਕਾ ਤਜਿ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer roRaa hoi rahu baat kaa taj man kaa abhimaan ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, let yourself be a pebble on the path; abandon your egotistical pride.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਕੋਈ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਤਾਹਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਭਗਵਾਨੁ ॥੧੪੬॥
lines.transliteration: aisaa koee daas hoi taahi milai bhagavaan ||146||
lines.translation: Such a humble slave shall meet the Lord God. ||146||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਰੋੜਾ ਹੂਆ ਤ ਕਿਆ ਭਇਆ ਪੰਥੀ ਕਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer roRaa hooaa ta kiaa bhaiaa pa(n)thee kau dukh dei ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, what good would it be, to be a pebble? It would only hurt the traveller on the path.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਸਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਧਰਨੀ ਮਹਿ ਖੇਹ ॥੧੪੭॥
lines.transliteration: aisaa teraa daas hai jiu dharanee mahi kheh ||147||
lines.translation: Your slave, O Lord, is like the dust of the earth. ||147||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਖੇਹ ਹੂਈ ਤਉ ਕਿਆ ਭਇਆ ਜਉ ਉਡਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਅੰਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer kheh hooee tau kiaa bhaiaa jau ud laagai a(n)g ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, what then, if one could become dust? It is blown up by the wind, and sticks to the body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਐਸਾ ਚਾਹੀਐ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਨੀ ਸਰਬੰਗ ॥੧੪੮॥
lines.transliteration: har jan aisaa chaaheeai jiu paanee saraba(n)g ||148||
lines.translation: The humble servant of the Lord should be like water, which cleans everything. ||148||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਪਾਨੀ ਹੂਆ ਤ ਕਿਆ ਭਇਆ ਸੀਰਾ ਤਾਤਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer paanee hooaa ta kiaa bhaiaa seeraa taataa hoi ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, what then, if one could become water? It becomes cold, then hot.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਐਸਾ ਚਾਹੀਐ ਜੈਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਹੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੧੪੯॥
lines.transliteration: har jan aisaa chaaheeai jaisaa har hee hoi ||149||
lines.translation: The humble servant of the Lord should be just like the Lord. ||149||

lines.gurmukhi: ਊਚ ਭਵਨ ਕਨਕਾਮਨੀ ਸਿਖਰਿ ਧਜਾ ਫਹਰਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ooch bhavan kanakaamanee sikhar dhajaa phaharaai ||
lines.translation: The banners wave above the lofty mansions, filled with gold and beautiful women.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਭਲੀ ਮਧੂਕਰੀ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੧੫੦॥
lines.transliteration: taa te bhalee madhookaree sa(n)tasa(n)g gun gaai ||150||
lines.translation: But better than these is dry bread, if one sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord in the Society of the Saints. ||150||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਪਾਟਨ ਤੇ ਊਜਰੁ ਭਲਾ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤ ਜਿਹ ਠਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer paatan te oojar bhalaa raam bhagat jih thaai ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the wilderness is better than a city, if the Lord's devotees live there.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਜਮ ਪੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਂਇ ॥੧੫੧॥
lines.transliteration: raam sanehee baaharaa jam pur mere bhaa(n)i ||151||
lines.translation: Without my Beloved Lord, it is like the City of Death for me. ||151||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਗੰਗ ਜਮੁਨ ਕੇ ਅੰਤਰੇ ਸਹਜ ਸੁੰਨ ਕੇ ਘਾਟ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer ga(n)g jamun ke a(n)tare sahaj su(n)n ke ghaat ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, between the Ganges and Jamunaa Rivers, on the shore of Celestial Silence,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਹਾ ਕਬੀਰੈ ਮਟੁ ਕੀਆ ਖੋਜਤ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਬਾਟ ॥੧੫੨॥
lines.transliteration: tahaa kabeerai mat keeaa khojat mun jan baat ||152||
lines.translation: there, Kabeer has made his home. The silent sages and the humble servants of the Lord search for the way to get there. ||152||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਜੈਸੀ ਉਪਜੀ ਪੇਡ ਤੇ ਜਉ ਤੈਸੀ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਓੜਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer jaisee upajee ped te jau taisee nibahai oR ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, if the mortal continues to love the Lord in the end, as he pledged in the beginning,

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੀਰਾ ਕਿਸ ਕਾ ਬਾਪੁਰਾ ਪੁਜਹਿ ਨ ਰਤਨ ਕਰੋੜਿ ॥੧੫੩॥
lines.transliteration: heeraa kis kaa baapuraa pujahi na ratan karoR ||153||
lines.translation: no poor diamond, not even millions of jewels, can equal him. ||153||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਅਚੰਭਉ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਹੀਰਾ ਹਾਟ ਬਿਕਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeeraa ek acha(n)bhau dekhio heeraa haat bikaai ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, I saw a strange and wonderful thing. A jewel was being sold in a store.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਨਜਨਹਾਰੇ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੧੫੪॥
lines.transliteration: banajanahaare baaharaa kaudee badalai jaai ||154||
lines.translation: Because there was no buyer, it was going in exchange for a shell. ||154||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰਾ ਜਹਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਤਹ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੈ ਜਹਾ ਝੂਠੁ ਤਹ ਪਾਪੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeeraa jahaa giaan tah dharam hai jahaa jhooth tah paap ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, where there is spiritual wisdom, there is righteousness and Dharma. Where there is falsehood, there is sin.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹਾ ਲੋਭੁ ਤਹ ਕਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਜਹਾ ਖਿਮਾ ਤਹ ਆਪਿ ॥੧੫੫॥
lines.transliteration: jahaa lobh tah kaal hai jahaa khimaa tah aap ||155||
lines.translation: Where there is greed, there is death. Where there is forgiveness, there is God Himself. ||155||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਤਜੀ ਤ ਕਿਆ ਭਇਆ ਜਉ ਮਾਨੁ ਤਜਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer maaiaa tajee ta kiaa bhaiaa jau maan tajiaa nahee jaai ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, what good is it to give up Maya, if the mortal does not give up his pride?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨ ਮੁਨੀ ਮੁਨਿਵਰ ਗਲੇ ਮਾਨੁ ਸਭੈ ਕਉ ਖਾਇ ॥੧੫੬॥
lines.transliteration: maan munee munivar gale maan sabhai kau khaai ||156||
lines.translation: Even the silent sages and seers are destroyed by pride; pride eats up everything. ||156||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਬਦੁ ਜੁ ਬਾਹਿਆ ਏਕੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer saachaa satigur mai miliaa sabad j baahiaa ek ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the True Guru has met me; He aimed the Arrow of the Shabad at me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਗਤ ਹੀ ਭੁਇ ਮਿਲਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਰਿਆ ਕਲੇਜੇ ਛੇਕੁ ॥੧੫੭॥
lines.transliteration: laagat hee bhui mil gaiaa pariaa kaleje chhek ||157||
lines.translation: As soon as it struck me, I fell to the ground with a hole in my heart. ||157||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੈ ਜਉ ਸਿਖਾ ਮਹਿ ਚੂਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer saachaa satigur kiaa karai jau sikhaa mahi chook ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, what can the True Guru do, when His Sikhs are at fault?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਏਕ ਨ ਲਾਗਈ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਂਸੁ ਬਜਾਈਐ ਫੂਕ ॥੧੫੮॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhe ek na laagaee jiu baa(n)s bajaaeeai phook ||158||
lines.translation: The blind do not take in any of His Teachings; it is as useless as blowing into bamboo. ||158||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਬੀਰ ਹੈ ਗੈ ਬਾਹਨ ਸਘਨ ਘਨ ਛਤ੍ਰਪਤੀ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kabeer hai gai baahan saghan ghan chhatrapatee kee naar ||
lines.translation: Kabeer, the wife of the king has all sorts of horses, elephants and carriages.
